verdict.rationale: Interview recording, transcription and AI summarization is a fair question for an ATS like Workable. However, the evidence pack documents no interview note-taking, transcription, summary-to-scorecard feature or consent handling. The Workable Agent covers only top-of-funnel sourcing and screening, and the candidate-rating API is an adjacent building block, not this capability.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled
